name: propose_action
description: Draft an action for the user to approve. Nothing is sent or changed yet. Use it once you have every fact the action needs. The response includes an action id and a plain summary of exactly what will be sent and to whom: read that summary aloud and ask the user for a clear yes before calling approve_action.

type.description: What kind of action to draft. cancel_subscription: cancel an unwanted subscription and email the vendor. submit_claim: claim a benefit or report a change of circumstances (e.g. add a child to Universal Credit). send_email: any other email, e.g. to the council or a vendor. fill_form: fill in an official form.

notification_id.description: The id of the alert this action is about, from get_notifications.

notes.description: Short plain-English notes for the drafter: the relevant facts the user confirmed in this conversation and anything they asked to include or leave out.
